run_fairchem_cli: run the fairchem CLI with a config YAML file and optional override arguments
canonicalize_omegaconf_config: canonicalize an OmegaConf DictConfig by resolving variables and removing unused top-level keys
load_hydra_config_from_yaml: load and merge a Hydra YAML config with a default JobConfig structured config
launch_slurm_job: launch a fairchem job on a SLURM cluster with optional Ray support
launch_local_job: launch a fairchem job locally with torch elastic or a local Ray cluster
